rule.name: ToMapDuplicateKey
rule.message: This Collectors.toMap has no merge function, but its keys come from parsed text or request data (a split string, file lines, cookies, headers, name-value pairs), where the same key can appear twice. The second one throws IllegalStateException: Duplicate key, so the code works in tests and fails on the first real input with a duplicate. Decide what a duplicate means: `toMap(Cookie::getName, Cookie::getValue, (first, second) -> first)` keeps the first (use second to keep the last, or throw with both values), or use `groupingBy` when duplicates are expected. An exception fits only for keys that are unique by construction (a stream that is distinct(), comes from a Set or from IntStream.range).

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $nameLike := ('getName', 'name', 'getKey', 'getHeaderName', 'getLabel'), $pairTypes := ('jakarta.servlet.http.Cookie', 'javax.servlet.http.Cookie', 'jakarta.ws.rs.core.Cookie', 'javax.ws.rs.core.Cookie', 'java.net.HttpCookie', 'org.springframework.http.HttpCookie', 'org.apache.http.Header', 'org.apache.http.NameValuePair', 'org.apache.hc.core5.http.Header', 'org.apache.hc.core5.http.NameValuePair', 'io.netty.handler.codec.http.cookie.Cookie') return //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('toMap', 'toUnmodifiableMap', 'toConcurrentMap')][ArgumentList[@Size = 2]] [pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.stream.Collectors#toMap(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.stream.Collectors#toUnmodifiableMap(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.stream.Collectors#toConcurrentMap(_*)')] [ancestor::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'collect'][1]/*[1]/descendant-or-self::MethodCall [@MethodName = ('split', 'lines', 'readAllLines', 'getCookies', 'splitToList', 'splitAsStream')] or ArgumentList/*[1]/descendant-or-self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('split', 'splitToList')] or ArgumentList/*[1][self::MethodReference][@MethodName = $nameLike] [*[1][some $t in $pairTypes satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($t)]] or ArgumentList/*[1][self::LambdaExpression]//MethodCall[@MethodName = $nameLike] [*[1][self::VariableAccess][some $t in $pairTypes satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($t)]]] [empty(ancestor::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'collect'][1]/*[1]/descendant-or-self::MethodCall [@MethodName = ('distinct', 'toSet', 'toUnmodifiableSet', 'toCollection', 'range', 'rangeClosed') or (@MethodName = 'stream' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Set')])])]
